usage_rules: Grade is optional; unknown is allowed. Never infer missing wavelength, pulse duration, frequency or measured depths.
Formula-derived model outputs are not measurement rows. Source-reported taper and independently recomputed taper are separate.
Use data according to output_semantics. Average, cumulative, scan depth and volume efficiency cannot be added to every pulse.
No independent validation of all material responses is claimed. This pack does not modify the GitHub repository.
Public article CC BY attribution retained in sources. Author-original XLSX was located, but NOT downloaded or included.
